title: DaylightPaint Command
description: Replace the daylight overlay: delete forsk:kind=analysis objects, then add one vertex-coloured mesh on A-ANALYSE with one square per cell. The layer is off in every layout detail and does not print. Sky-vis proxy, not lux.

z.description: Mesh height in mm, usually the floor plus 50.

cells.description: One [x, y, r, g, b] per usable cell: centre in mm, colour 0-255 from the Planwire ramp.
